personality_one_liner: A dignified, text-led, and reverent editorial experience that uses warm parchment tones, classic Arabic typography, and generous breathing room to tell the stories of the prophets.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like vertical rhythm. Let Arabic typography breathe with increased line-heights (1.6x for body, 1.4x for display) to account for diacritics (Tashkeel). Use padding to frame content like a page in a book.

dont's: No glassmorphism for this app. The Editorial personality relies on solid parchment tones and flat borders to feel like a physical book or magazine.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A calm entry point featuring the 'Story of the Day', recent reads, and a clear gateway to the Kids section.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner with 'جاري التحميل...' text.
states.error: Soft error message with a retry button in brandPrimary.

screens.layout: RTL mandatory. Top header: App title in Amiri font. Below header: Large full-width hero card (Story of the Day) with a desert/starry night background image, gradient scrim, and white Amiri title overlaid. Below hero: Section titled 'أكمل القراءة' (Continue Reading) with horizontal scrolling cards. Bottom section: Large promotional banner for the Kids section (قسم الأطفال) with softer, playful background colors but maintaining the editorial structure.

screens.name: StoriesList
screens.purpose: Browse all prophets with tabs for chronological (ترتيب زمني) and alphabetical (ترتيب أبجدي) order.

states.loading: Skeleton list rows simulating Arabic text.
states.empty: No stories found (Search state) with a clean calligraphy graphic.

screens.layout: Sticky top search bar. Below search: Two-segment tab control (Chronological / Alphabetical). List items are tall (72pt) with the Prophet's name in large Amiri font on the right (RTL), a brief subtitle (e.g., location/era) in Cairo font below it, and an elegant chevron on the left. No figurative avatars; use a subtle geometric pattern circle or just clean typography.

screens.name: StoryDetail
screens.purpose: Deep, immersive reading experience for a single prophet's story, supplemented with video, miracles, and lessons.
screens.layout: Top: A subtle header with back button (left) and bookmark (right). Full-width hero section with a thematic nature image (e.g., sea for Musa, desert for Saleh) and a gradient scrim holding the Prophet's name in oversized Amiri font. Below hero: segmented control or sticky anchor links (القصة - Story, المعجزات - Miracles, الدروس - Lessons). Content area is heavily text-focused with generous line height. YouTube video player embedded elegantly inline within the 'Story' section. A sticky floating action button (FAB) at the bottom left for 'Listen (استمع)' launching the TTS audio.

screens.name: AudioPlayer
screens.purpose: Dedicated screen for TTS narration of the story, accessible via Mini Player.
screens.layout: Modal bottom sheet or full screen. Minimalist layout. A central large calligraphic artwork representing the prophet. Below it: large title, playback controls (Play/Pause, Seek 15s forward/back, timeline scrubber). Very clean, relying on whitespace. Mini-player floats above bottom tabs globally when audio is active.

screens.name: KidsSection
screens.purpose: A slightly simplified, engaging interface for children's stories and quizzes, keeping the app's dignity but adding warmth.
screens.layout: Uses the same typography but leans more on `brandSecondary` (Gold) and `surfaceTertiary` to feel slightly warmer and more tactile. Two main tabs: Stories (simplified text) and Quizzes. Quiz layout: Question in large text at the top, followed by large, easily tappable answer cards. Feedback (Correct/Incorrect) uses tactile colors (success/error) with gentle haptic feedback.

hero_background_night.alt: Starry night sky over rocky desert landscape used for Story of the Day

geometric_pattern.alt: Islamic geometric pattern used for subtle backgrounds and empty states

calligraphy_art.alt: Clean Arabic calligraphy text used as a placeholder or decorative element

instructions_to_main_agent: RTL Layout is non-negotiable. Use `I18nManager.forceRTL(true);` and ensure all UI elements (chevrons, back buttons, text alignment) respect RTL.
Do not use any figurative images or illustrations of people/prophets. Only use nature photography (deserts, mountains, seas), geometric Islamic patterns, or Arabic calligraphy.
Use `@expo-google-fonts/amiri` for display/headings and `@expo-google-fonts/cairo` for body text. Ensure line-heights are generous to accommodate Arabic diacritics.
Implement the TTS audio feature using standard audio playback libraries (e.g., `expo-av`) with a global mini-player anchored above the bottom tab bar.
The Editorial personality requires restraint. Do not use glassmorphism, heavy shadows, or bright colors. Rely on the contrast between the parchment-like backgrounds and the deep green/gold accents.
For any image with text over it (like the hero card), implement a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to 70-80% surfaceInverse) to ensure text readability.

Ensure the Kids Section feels integrated but distinct, perhaps by using larger rounded corners (md to lg) and leaning more on the gold accent color to feel slightly more playful while maintaining dignity.
